d: America's Diwali story has two very different sides. President Donald Trump hosts a Diwali gala at the White House, political leaders extend festive greetings, and cities across the country open public spaces for celebrations. Yet, online, former intelligence chief Tulsi Gabbard and FBI Director Kash Patel face religious abuse. In Seattle, a Diwali celebration is disrupted by far-right activist Jake Lang and his supporters, drawing condemnation from Indian-American lawmakers. So, while Diwali gains visibility and recognition in America, why are members of the Hindu community still facing…
